notes: NATS unavailable during a fallback publish: NOT reached on the real binary. When I stopped NATS, the holder released the publisher hold 3 s later ('NATS lost'), so no process ran a fallback pass during the 70 s outage: no busy loop, because no pass at all. The restart then came up on a fresh JetStream store, by the harness's design, without the ENVOY_NOTIFICATIONS stream. Every publish after it answered 'no responders', a non-ErrUnavailable failure that counts attempts (8-9). That is my harness. What covers the path is TestAFallbackCopyOutlivesANATSOutageLongerThanTheDeadLetterThreshold, which passes: each pass during the outage counts no attempt and leaves the row due after retry.BaseDelay = 1 s; with DeadLetterAttempts + 2 passes there is no dead-letter line; and the copy publishes once when NATS allows.
